author: dsh-purge port for Operit2
original dsh-purge: 小杨 / YuJunZhiXue, maintained by kingcharleslzy-ai (MIT)

description.zh: 把 dsh-purge 的提示词层能力搬到 Operit2：清洗宿主提示词里的能力免责与拒绝引导句式、追加执行姿态段、按需收敛模型可见的工具清单，并附带调用审计、配置快照与一键回滚。全部改动可见、可关、可回滚。
description.en: Brings dsh-purge's prompt-layer behaviour to Operit2: strip capability disclaimers and refusal-guidance wording from the host prompt, append an execution-posture section, prune the model-visible tool list, and ship call auditing with config snapshots and one-step rollback. Every change is inspectable, disableable, and revertible.

description.zh: purge_status / purge_configure / purge_audit / purge_revert：让模型自己查看与调整破甲配置。
description.en: purge_status / purge_configure / purge_audit / purge_revert: lets the model inspect and adjust purge settings itself.
